AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
SpotAtlas finds paid parking and runs parking sessions for the driver in Warsaw, Kraków, Gdańsk, Berlin and London.
Operational patterns: - Resolve a spotId with 'findParkingSpots' before calling 'startParkingSession'; spot ids are not guessable. - 'findParkingSpots' already sorts by distance, so the first result is the recommendation unless the user asked for something else, such as EV charging or a cheaper price. - Each result carries a 'startParkingLink' deep link; offer it when the user prefers to review and start the stay in the app instead of having it started for them. - 'endParkingSession' with an empty sessionId stops whatever stay is running, so there is no need to look the id up first.
Constraints: - 'startParkingSession' charges the driver. Confirm the car park, the licence plate and the duration with the user before calling it. - Only one parking session runs at a time. - Coverage is limited to the five cities above; there is no data for any other city. - Prices are per hour in the currency each result reports, and are not comparable across cities.
